title: Eld — acceptance checklist
note: BASELINE created 2026-07-29. Until now this module had NO acceptance list, so "completely built" had no definition and no honest percentage could be shown. Every item starts OPEN because none has been verified — this is a scope statement, not a claim of failure. M grows when new surfaces or defects appear (Rule 21). M GROWN 1 -> 5 on 2026-07-29 (Rule 21): the landing route verified live, which revealed 4 further tabs inside it. Counting the module complete on its landing surface alone would have been a wave-slice close.

items.title: Surface /eld renders real entity-scoped data with no dead end
items.evidence: VERIFIED LIVE on prod 2026-07-29 in BOTH entities. 5 tabs (Live Duty Status, HOS Violations, Unidentified Driving, Driver Certifications, ELD Settings). TRANSP: 6 drivers on the canonical roster from GET /api/v1/telematics/hos/daily-roster with real duty status, drive-left and shift-left values (e.g. T176 Sleeper Berth 10h54m / 3h51m). USMCA: 0 rows with an explicit honest-empty message, 'No HOS duty events for this company today (honest empty — ingest may be quiet)' — an honest empty, not a silent blank.
